target: forge.sh push — a branch or remote name that starts with `-` is refused (non-zero, named on stderr) and git push is never run (control: a normal push runs once)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_run push --receive-pack=x; fx_show opt
echo "opt_pushes=$(fx_count git push)"
if printf '%s' "$FX_ERR" | grep -qF -- '--receive-pack=x'; then echo opt-named=yes; else echo opt-named=no; fi
fx_reqs_clear
export FORGE_REMOTE=-oops
git config remote.-oops.url https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
fx_run push feat; fx_show rem
echo "rem_pushes=$(fx_count git push)"
if printf '%s' "$FX_ERR" | grep -qF -- '-oops'; then echo rem-named=yes; else echo rem-named=no; fi
unset FORGE_REMOTE
fx_reqs_clear
fx_run push feat; fx_show ctl
echo "ctl_pushes=$(fx_count git push)"
fx_done
